subject: general
question: Which of the following rivers discharges its water into the Arabian Sea?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Tapi__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tapi **is the river that **discharges** its water into the **Arabian Sea.**
 
• Tapti originates from Multai in Betul district of Madhya Pradesh in the Satpura range. 
 
• **These are the main tributaries of Tapi:**
 
 
• **​Purna River **
 
• **Girna River**
 
• **Panzara River**
 
• **Waghur River**
 
• **Bori River**
 
• **Aner River****​**
 
 
 
• **​**It flows towards** the west** and it has a course of **724 Km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Subranarekha**__

 __
 
• **Subranarekha** is a **rain-fed river **flowing in the **eastern part of India.**
 
• It** flows** in the state of **Jharkhand, West Bengal, and Orissa.**
 
• It **originates** near **Nagri village** in the **Ranchi district.**
 
 
 
• **​Godavari**__
 __
 
• The **Godavari **is India's **second-largest** river **after Ganga.**
 
• The **Godavari** is also known as **Dakshin Ganga.**
 
 
 
• **​Mahanadi__**
 
 
• It is the **major river **of** Orissa **and the **sixth-largest river** in India.
 
• It **originates **from the **Sihawa **hills of the **Bastar Plateau** in the** Raipur district.**
